description: This install program copies files (often just compiled) into destination locations you choose.

option.name: --backup
tip: make a backup of each existing destination file

option.name: --compare
tip: compare content of source and destination files, and if no change to content, ownership, and permissions, do not modify the destination at all

option.name: --context
tip: like -Z, or if CTX is specified then set the SELinux or SMACK security context to CTX

option.name: --debug
tip: explain how a file is copied. Implies -v

option.name: --directory
tip: treat all arguments as directory names; create all components of the specified directories

option.name: --group
tip: set group ownership, instead of process' current group

option.name: --mode
tip: set permission mode (as in chmod), instead of rwxr-xr-x

option.name: --no-target-directory
tip: treat DEST as a normal file

option.name: --owner
tip: set ownership (super-user only)

option.name: --preserve-context
tip: preserve SELinux security context

option.name: --preserve-timestamps
tip: apply access/modification times of SOURCE files to corresponding destination files

option.name: --strip
tip: strip symbol tables

option.name: --strip-program
tip: program used to strip binaries

option.name: --suffix
tip: override the usual backup suffix

option.name: --target-directory
tip: copy all SOURCE arguments into DIRECTORY

option.name: --verbose
tip: print the name of each created file or directory

option.name: -b
tip: like --backup but does not accept an argument

option.name: -c
tip: (ignored)

option.name: -D
tip: create all leading components of DEST except the last, or all components of --target-directory, then copy SOURCE to DEST

option.name: -Z
tip: set SELinux security context of destination file and each created directory to default type

global_option.name: --help
tip: display this help and exit

global_option.name: --version
tip: output version information and exit
